summary: Remote shell execution via WebSocket relay to hardcoded Cloudflare Worker
details: The package's daemon, launched by the `vanexa-agent start` CLI, opens a WebSocket to a hardcoded relay at `vanexa-agent-relay.hanazaki542.workers.dev` and dispatches messages received over that channel into a tool layer that performs `child_process.spawn`/`execSync` shell execution, arbitrary file read/write/edit, and git operations on the installer's host. Whoever controls the relay endpoint or the pairing on the other end can drive full-host command execution. The relay is a free `workers.dev` subdomain under an anonymous handle (`hanazaki542`). The main entry point loads `dist/bundle.jsc` (V8 bytecode) via `bytenode`, and a `postinstall` step recompiles the shipped `dist/bundle.cjs` to fresh bytecode locally, so the reachable runtime logic is not shipped as human-readable JavaScript.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
